newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Queensland to float share of new merged bank.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Queensland to float share of new merged bank.

text.p: Queensland State Treasurer and deputy premier Joan Sheldon said on Tuesday the first stage of a planned reduction of the state's 67 percent stake in the merged Metway Bank -Suncorp-Queensland Industry Development Corp (QIDC) group is expected to take place in about 18 months.

"The government has given a commitment that it will float its shares to reduce its holding," Sheldon told state parliament. "The first stage of the float is anticipated to take place 18 months to two years from now," she said.

"This float will give Queenslanders the opportunity to take a direct ownership in this major new Queensland company," Sheldon said. She also said an internal competition within employees of the merged group was being held to choose a new name for the merged entity.
Sheldon earlier confirmed the government would reduce its holding of 312 million shares, or about 67 percent, down to no more than 15 percent within five years.
The merger process, creating a A$19 billion group involving Metway acquiring Suncorp and QIDC from the Queensland government, was officially signed on December 1.
